title: Individual Fairness via Local Predictive Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2610.33285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Individual fairness in machine learning requires that similar individuals receive similar predictions. Most existing definitions are pairwise in nature, imposing a Lipschitz constraint that must hold either globally across all pairs of data instances or locally within specified neighborhoods. In practice, however, such pairwise constraints may be overly restrictive and may not directly identify which individuals receive locally inconsistent predictions. We study local predictive consistency as a node-level relaxation of pairwise individual fairness, where each prediction is compared with a similarity-weighted average of predictions in its local neighborhood. This yields an interpretable node-level fairness score and a corresponding regularized learning approach based on local residuals. translated_title: 通过局部预测一致性实现个体公平性
translated_abstract: 机器学习中的个体公平性要求相似的个体获得相似的预测。现有的大多数定义在本质上是成对的，即施加一个Lipschitz约束，该约束要么必须在所有数据实例对之间全局成立，要么在指定的邻域内局部成立。然而在实践中，这类成对约束可能过于严格，并且无法直接识别出哪些个体收到了局部不一致的预测。我们研究局部预测一致性作为成对个体公平性的一种节点级松弛形式，即将每个预测与其局部邻域内预测的相似度加权平均值进行比较。由此得到一个可解释的节点级公平性评分，以及一种基于局部残差的相应正则化学习方法。由于基于图的个体公平性关键取决于底层的相似性结构，我们将邻域图的构建加以明确化……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将局部预测一致性作为成对个体公平性的节点级松弛方法，通过将每个预测与其邻域内相似度加权平均预测进行比较，实现了可解释的节点级公平性评分和基于局部残差的正则化学习框架。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes local predictive consistency as a node-level relaxation of pairwise individual fairness, comparing each prediction with a similarity-weighted average of predictions in its local neighborhood, which yields an interpretable node-level fairness score and a regularized learning approach based on local residuals.
